name: Nafeez
biography: Ahamed Nafeez has a varied offensive security background with some emphasis on browsers, web services, and cryptography. He believes defending is much harder than attacking most of the time and appreciates the variables and challenges defenders have. These days he is interested in writing secure frameworks, automating attacks and more or less trying to learn to write good code. He has spoken at a few security conferences in the past around web apps, browsers and security analysis of javascript. He tweets at @skeptic_fx and builds his side project assetwatch.io in free time, an automated asset discovery/monitoring service.
